payload.title: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-007: Add configurable diff and token limits with truncation warnings
payload.body:
## Summary

Add configurable **max tokens**, **max diff size**, and structured job logging (criterion count, truncated diff flag, token usage when available) so cost and context stay bounded; the PR comment must **explicitly warn** when context was truncated.

## Scope

- In scope: Repo/org variables for limits; truncation of diff (and any other large inputs) before LLM call; warning section in posted markdown; structured logs per PRD §6.
- Out of scope: Changing LLM provider billing — only client-side limits.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A fixture with an **oversized diff** triggers the **truncation** path and the posted summary includes an explicit **“partial context”** / truncation warning (PRD §3 journey 4).
- [ ] **Max tokens** and **max diff** (bytes/lines — document unit) are configurable via workflow inputs or environment variables with **documented defaults** aligned to economical v1 usage.
- [ ] Job logs include **structured** lines or fields for: number of criteria, whether diff was truncated, and token usage **if** the API returns it.
- [ ] Unit tests cover truncation boundary behavior.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005
- Blocks: none

## Notes

After this lands, revisit GHA-PR-LLM-AC-003 if LLM-based AC segmentation is used — apply the same limits.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/pr-github-llm-ticket-acceptance.prd.md
